run_xpo_training: run XPO training on a causal language model with a reward model using command-line arguments
create_xpo_trainer: create an XPOTrainer instance with a causal LM, reference model, reward model, and dataset
configure_xpo_args: configure XPO training arguments including learning rate, batch size, epochs, and missing EOS penalty
load_quantized_model: load a quantized causal language model and reference model for XPO fine-tuning
log_training_completions: log model completions during XPO evaluation using a generation config and callback
